title: DirectoryRequest
description: Request body for starting a directory export job

responseFormat.description: Output format for the exported file. Supported values: `ndjson` (Newline Delimited JSON) or `csv` (Comma Separated Values), the default is `ndjson`. If not specified, defaults to 'ndjson'.

templateId.description: Optional egress template ID for a template-driven export. When provided, the export uses the template's column mappings instead of the legacy pipeline. The template must belong to the tenant and have status=active, or the request fails with 400. If `responseFormat` is also supplied, it must match the template's configured output format or the request fails with 400.

mappingsCsvUrl.description: Optional GCS URL to column mappings CSV for template pipeline

filters.description: Optional NPI and/or TIN filters. When provided, only matching entities are exported and both fields are combined with OR logic. TIN-only filters are rejected for practitioners exports (400).

from.description: Start of the export window as a UTC calendar date (`yyyy-MM-dd`, inclusive). Required together with `to` when `templateId` is a Manual Change File template; rejected with 400 for Scheduled Change File templates and for full roster exports.

to.description: End of the export window as a UTC calendar date (`yyyy-MM-dd`, inclusive); must not precede `from`. See `from`.

npi.description: List of NPIs to filter by (each must be exactly 10 digits). Capped at 100 entries by default; omit to export all NPIs.

tin.description: List of TINs to filter by (each must be exactly 9 digits). Capped at 100 entries by default; omit to export all TINs. Not supported for practitioners exports when npi is absent.
